name: Nextcloud
description: Run a self-hosted file synchronization and collaboration service for a small personal installation.
limitations: This KITPro profile is a single-container SQLite deployment intended only for minimal personal use.
Nextcloud discourages SQLite for sync-client and multi-user workloads; use this profile primarily for small browser-based installations.
This KITPro profile does not deploy an external database, Redis, or a high-availability topology.
Ingress is optional and remains disabled by default; trusted-proxy application settings are still administrator-owned.
Future Nextcloud version transitions require a reviewed backup and one-major-version-at-a-time validation.
